intro.title: Map n' Seek
intro.paragraph1: Koto City has many evacuation shelters, but do you know where they are, what makes each one different, and whether they are truly safe in an emergency?
intro.paragraph2: I’m going to hide at one of the evacuation shelters somewhere in Koto City. As you walk through the city, collect clues related to flood risk and try to find the shelter where I’m hiding.
intro.paragraph3: Even in a familiar neighborhood, you may notice places you’ve never paid attention to before - streets you’ve never walked, subtle changes in elevation, or hidden details in the landscape.
intro.paragraph4: As you explore, think about the connections between the city, evacuation shelters, and flood risk. Let’s walk through our community and learn about the risks together.

one.title: Find Mobi
one.body: Walk through the city and find the evacuation shelter where "Mobi" is hiding.
one.imageAlt: Onboarding illustration showing Mobi hiding in a shelter

two.title: Ask location-based questions
two.body:
When you visit disaster-related points around the city, such as schools, stations, or bridges, you can ask a question related to that specific location.

For example:
Hazard Area Questions: At a shelter -> "Is the flood depth at X 5-10 meters?"
Shelter Questions: At a shelter -> "Is X an elementary school?"
Nearby Amenities Questions: At a bridge -> "Are there Y bridges nearby?"
two.imageAlt: Onboarding illustration showing city points with question prompts

three.title: Narrow the candidates
three.body: You may ask only one question per location. Use each answer, correct or incorrect, as a clue to narrow down the possible shelters where "Mobi" could be hiding.
three.imageAlt: Onboarding illustration showing clue-based shelter filtering

four.title: Submit your final answer
four.body: Once you think you have identified the shelter where "Mobi" is located, final answer. Submit your response.
four.imageAlt: Onboarding illustration prompting the final answer

five.title: Start with the nearest shelter
five.body: First, try going to the nearest "Evacuation Shelter." Ask a hazard layer question to significantly narrow the search area and progress through the game efficiently.
five.imageAlt: Onboarding illustration guiding the player to the nearest shelter

help.title: How to Play
help.subtitle: Learn the tools and strategy to find the secret shelter

mapLayers.title: Map Layers
mapLayers.body: Tap the icon in the upper left to open the layer control and choose what information to display on the map. Layers are divided into four categories: Evacuation Shelters, Evacuation Support Facilities, Other Facilities, and Hazard Layers. You can select and view the information needed for the game.

askQuestion.title: Ask a Question
askQuestion.body: Tap "Ask a Question" at the bottom of the screen to open the question window. The questions you can ask depend on your current location. You can ask only one question from a single location, and you cannot ask multiple questions consecutively from the same place. After you ask a question, that question is locked for two minutes.

clues.title: Clues and Final Answer
clues.body:
Tap the light bulb icon in the upper right to open Clues and Final Answer. The clues you obtain from questions are displayed here. By tapping "Show on Map", you can display the designated evacuation shelters on the map that match the clue.

Once you know the correct answer, submit it from "Identify Shelter" in the red box.

measurement.title: Measurement Mode
measurement.body: Tap the ruler icon in the upper right to open Measurement Radius. When you tap a point on the map, you can count how many facilities are within a 250 m radius from that point. To count them, the facility layer must be checked in the layer control and make them visible on the map.

playTips.one: First, try going to the nearest Evacuation Shelter. When you approach one of the green icons on the map, you can ask a hazard layer question. Using hazard layer questions to narrow down the search area significantly will help you progress through the game more efficiently.
playTips.two: Once you have narrowed the search to a smaller area, refine it further by asking about the facility type. You can also ask these questions when you are near an Evacuation Shelter. Is the secret shelter an elementary school? A middle school? A high school? Or another type of facility? This step helps reduce the number of possible options.
playTips.three: Finally, narrow down the options using the number of nearby facilities. When you are near an Evacuation Support Facility or Other Facility, you can ask how many of that facility exist within a 250m radius of the secret shelter. For example, if you are near an AED, you can guess and ask how many AEDs are located within 250m of the secret shelter. Tap the ruler icon in the upper right to use the measurement tool, and count how many facilities are within 250m of each candidate shelter. Use this information to ask questions strategically.
playTips.four: When you ask a question and obtain a correct clue, it is saved under the light bulb icon in the upper right. Tap "Show on Map" to display the shelters that match the clue on the map.
playTips.five: Once you determine the secret shelter, submit your Final Answer from the same light bulb menu. You can submit up to three answers. Walk around the city strategically and find the secret shelter where "Mobi" is hiding.
